items.docs:
The `useruuid` is the unique identifier of a user in the system. It is assigned when the user is created and can be retrieved through **GET Users** API.
**Authorization** OAuth token issued by the Identity Broker. One of the following OAuth scopes is required: - `identity:people_rw`. - `identity:people_read`.
